package_identity.stable_package_use: P011 acceptance only; it does not contain P018/P019-only behavior

phases.name: Read-only inspection
phases.entry_gate: operator present, direct recovery available, and initial read-only work authorized
operations: identify device
inspect package and installed paths
inspect daemon, socket, launchd, recovery journal, policy, schedules, telemetry, logs, and evidence

phases.name: Package acceptance
phases.entry_gate: P011 exact artifact and signer provenance verified; installation separately authorized
operations: follow P011 stable v0.1.0 acceptance procedure
verify installed package and paths
prepare a separately identified signed development candidate only after its provenance is complete
phases.state_changes_allowed: only individually authorized P011 package actions

phases.name: Foreground daemon lifecycle
phases.entry_gate: P011 acceptance, candidate identity, clean P014 state, and separate session authorization
operations: foreground start
existing IPC
read-only status
clean manual shutdown
separate process-exit and socket-cleanup observations
record assertion ownership and recovery journal

phases.name: Controlled idle and SSH comparison
phases.entry_gate: P012 prerequisites and the exact P012 v1 trial definitions are satisfied
operations: manually conduct the fixed 24-trial A/B/C/D matrix
one route and at most one SSH probe per trial
preserve quiet interval, fixed orders, missing outcomes, and clock uncertainty
phases.state_changes_allowed: one separately authorized bounded assertion in C trials only

phases.name: Repeated bounded reliability sessions
phases.entry_gate: Phases 0 through 3 pass safety review and no unresolved cleanup remains
operations: three attended observation periods on separate calendar dates
four operator-started bounded cycles per period
record rest, carryover, network, resource, process, and cleanup observations
phases.state_changes_allowed: one manually started assertion per cycle; no automated series or silent renewal

phases.name: Lifecycle and recovery review
phases.entry_gate: prior phases complete and evidence preserved
operations: review supported P013/P014 behavior and records
observe clean manual shutdown and recovery state
leave launchd mutation, restart automation, reboot, respring, crash injection, and journal reset disabled

endurance_plan.sample_rationale: Twelve manually separated cycles across three dates are an initial recurrence and cleanup consistency screen, not a failure-rate certification. The P012 24-probe matrix is a separate exploratory comparison. Neither duration aggregation nor a zero-failure finite sample establishes 24/7 reliability.

observation_design.clock_reconciliation: Never compare unrelated monotonic clocks. Cross-device event order is INCONCLUSIVE without an independently documented UTC reconciliation that accounts for both uncertainties.
observation_design.lan_and_tailscale: Keep LAN and Tailscale authenticated SSH results separate. One route per trial and no retry. A reachable peer or TCP port is not authenticated SSH.
observation_design.resource_sources: Keep P016 API readings separate from operator observations. UNAVAILABLE is not zero, full battery, or nominal temperature. Defer a trial when available evidence cannot support a safe resource review.

inclusion_criteria: The current package, source, signing profile, signer, installed paths, and rollback artifact are identified and reviewed.
The operator is physically present and has an independent recovery method for the full attended session.
P014 assertion ownership and recovery journal are known, consistent, and safe before each phase.
Every individual operation has its required separate authorization and stays within the registered time ceiling.
Required observations, source classes, timestamps, uncertainty, and condition state are recorded.
P012 trial records match protocol v1, including the quiet interval, route/order, screen lock, one-probe limit, and confirmed release.
exclusion_criteria: Any required state, source, timestamp, timebase, package identity, or cleanup result is unknown or contradictory.
A quiet interval is missing or contaminated, a trial is duplicated, or route/condition/repetition order differs from P012 v1.
The observer timebases cannot establish that a condition C probe preceded assertion release.
Battery or thermal evidence is unavailable and an independent operator review cannot establish safe conditions.
A reboot, respring, clock discontinuity, interruption, or carryover makes the registered comparison invalid.
stop_conditions: Assertion release failed or cannot be confirmed.
P014 recovery state becomes unsafe, corrupt, or inconsistent.
Unexpected daemon restart or process exit.
Battery or thermal concern, or resource evidence no longer supports safe continuation.
Package, installed binary, signer, or build identity mismatch.
Service, socket, lock, or assertion ownership state becomes inconsistent.
Persistent state corruption or required observation loss.
The approved test duration or 300-second assertion ceiling is exceeded.
A prior trial leaves daemon, socket, assertion, or recovery state uncertain.

failure_handling.ssh_failure: Record one route-specific outcome; do not retry. Continue only if the preregistered safety rule permits and all safety state remains known.
failure_handling.unsafe_stop: Stop all further trials, preserve incomplete records, keep the operator present, and use only a separately authorized manual recovery plan.

analysis_plan.latency: Report successful authenticated SSH latency using host monotonic elapsed time with n, median, quartiles, minimum, and maximum.
claim_limits: Do not add independent short sessions into a continuous uptime interval

evidence_review.p009_event_extension: P009 v1 remains unchanged. P019 records interrupted trials, charging categories, period/cycle identifiers, and protocol deviations in its own versioned session format. If acceptance requires a new P009 event meaning, submit a versioned extension proposal before collection.
